description: This file declares asynchronous subscription functions for the rbus messaging library, including functions to add, remove, retrieve, and close subscriptions.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription with specified event subscription data and message payload.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes an existing subscription based on the given subscription data.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_GetSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription handle based on handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the subscription handle, cleaning up resources.
